notes.title: Version 1.151
notes.notes:
[h1]The Short Version[/h1]
[list]
[*]Attempted fix for situations where a weapon breaking will cause the player to be unable to interact with anything
[/list]

[h1]The Long Version[/h1]
For some reason every version of this "player suddenly can't attack or pick anything up" bug is difficult or impossible to reproduce on my end, so I have no idea if this actually works.  In theory it [i]should[/i] make extra sure that you can always interact with things if your hands are empty, but I have no way to test it because I can't reproduce the bug it's trying to fix.  In a perfect world, bugs like this would not exist.  But this is not a perfect world.

SO... in other words this should fix issues where your weapon breaks and suddenly you can't interact with anything.  If it doesn't please let me know.

notes.title: Version 1.15
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where holding block with certain weapons while picking up another weapon would cause the player to be unable to attack or block
[*]Attempted fix for other possible cases where the player becomes unable to attack or interact
[*]Player can no longer switch between weapon and camera while attack is held, to prevent a bug that could keep them from being able to interact or attack
[/list]
